# Atlantic Accommodation

> Owner-managed, self-catering holiday rentals in Langebaan and Dolphin Beach (Table View, Cape Town) on South Africa's Cape West Coast. Guests enquire and book directly with the owners, or through the same homes' listings on Airbnb or Booking.com.

Atlantic Accommodation is the holiday-rental side of the Atlantic family, the same owners behind Atlantic Yachting at Club Mykonos, Langebaan. Guests deal directly with the owners. Rates are given on enquiry; the website does not list fixed prices.

## Properties

- [Atlantic Beach Cottage](https://www.atlanticaccommodation.co.za/properties/beach-cottage.html): Light-filled self-catering cottage a short stroll from Langebaan Lagoon, with a patio and indoor-outdoor living. 2 bedrooms, both en-suite.
- [Atlantic Apartment](https://www.atlanticaccommodation.co.za/properties/apartment.html): Modern self-catering apartment in Langebaan, close to shops, restaurants and the waterfront. 2 bedrooms (one king, one twin), sleeps 4, private balcony with a braai.
- [Atlantic Seaview](https://www.atlanticaccommodation.co.za/properties/seaview-dolphin-beach.html): Bright beachfront self-catering home at Dolphin Beach Estate, Table View, Cape Town, with Atlantic Ocean and Table Mountain views. 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, sleeps 2; the estate has a communal pool and garden.
- [All properties](https://www.atlanticaccommodation.co.za/properties.html): Overview of all three homes with booking links.

## How to book

- Direct with the owners: send an enquiry through the form on the [contact page](https://www.atlanticaccommodation.co.za/contact.html) (or the Enquire button on each property page). The owners reply to confirm availability, rates and details.
- Through a platform: each property page links to that home's Airbnb and Booking.com listing.
- Each property page shows an availability calendar.
